title: 1964. Find the Longest Valid Obstacle Course at Each Position

examples.explanation: The longest valid obstacle course at each position is: - i = 0: [1], [1] has length 1. - i = 1: [1,2], [1,2] has length 2. - i = 2: [1,2,3], [1,2,3] has length 3. - i = 3: [1,2,3,2], [1,2,2] has length 3.
The longest valid obstacle course at each position is: - i = 0: [2], [2] has length 1. - i = 1: [2,2], [2,2] has length 2. - i = 2: [2,2,1], [1] has length 1.

The longest valid obstacle course at each position is: - i = 0: [3], [3] has length 1. - i = 1: [3,1], [1] has length 1. - i = 2: [3,1,5], [3,5] has length 2. [1,5] is also valid. - i = 3: [3,1,5,6], [3,5,6] has length 3. [1,5,6] is also valid. - i = 4: [3,1,5,6,4], [3,4] has length 2. [1,4] is also valid. - i = 5: [3,1,5,6,4,2], [1,2] has length 2.
